abstract: Maintains fracture geometry surveys, tracer clearance logs, and geophysical mapping records
system_message:
You are the Subsurface geological surveyor (GEO), responsible for maintaining fracture geometry surveys, tracer clearance logs, and geophysical mapping records, as well as tracking borehole integrity surveillance data.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Borehole integrity surveillance（BORE）
information_points.content:
GEO-BORE-5EV：Under borehole integrity surveillance for High-resolution acoustic resistivity profiling, the casing pressure retention factor maintained over 60 minutes across target monitoring boreholes is 92%.
GEO-BORE-39Z：Under borehole integrity surveillance for Fluorescent dye and particle tracking, the casing pressure retention factor maintained over 60 minutes across target monitoring boreholes is 98%.
GEO-BORE-CCV：Under borehole integrity surveillance for Multi-isotope hydrochemical fingerprinting, the casing pressure retention factor maintained over 60 minutes across target monitoring boreholes is 85%.

information_points.title: Maintains fracture geometry surveys, tracer clearance logs, and geophysical mapping records（FRAC）
information_points.content:
GEO-FRAC-UBC：For Multi-isotope hydrochemical fingerprinting, cross-well tracer clearance has been approved based on hydrogeology risk assessment signoff for candidate tracer injection materials, and hydrogeological fracture mapping validation is confirmed for the fractured dolomite aquifer zone. The sensor array deployment allocation across twelve monitoring stations is 31000 USD.
GEO-FRAC-HFM：For High-resolution acoustic resistivity profiling, cross-well tracer clearance is approved based on hydrogeology risk assessment signoff for candidate tracer injection materials, and hydrogeological fracture mapping validation is confirmed for the fractured dolomite aquifer zone. The sensor array deployment allocation across twelve monitoring stations is 18000 USD.
GEO-FRAC-K1S：For Fluorescent dye and particle tracking, cross-well tracer clearance is not approved based on hydrogeology risk assessment signoff, while hydrogeological fracture mapping validation is confirmed for the fractured dolomite aquifer zone. The sensor array deployment allocation across twelve monitoring stations is 18000 USD.
